answer: The wander counter is kept in nadir and island publishes each reset. Someone therefore has to keep every sock puppet continuously active for 30 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 30 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 3472 identities would post 3500 proofs and burn roughly 51 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
